category_title: Reintegrated learners with BESD exhibiting social-emotional dysregulation and authority defiance
scenario_title: Catching up on lost work in a mainstream classroom
minimal_context: The student is in a mainstream classroom attempting to catch up on lost worksheet assignments while peers are present.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your desk and start catching up on the worksheet you missed yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even know what to do. I was feeling angry all the time and I can't concentrate on this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to focus on the paper and get it done.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns around to the desk behind) Stop looking at my paper! The only reason I am bad is because people wind me up and I cannot control my behaviour.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please ignore them and get back to your own work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the worksheet off the desk and starts talking loudly to the peers) No! I would rather disrupt than do this. You're all winding me up!
